_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Data Module Requirements List for S1000D
summary: Establishes the format and content requirements for the Data Module Requirements List used to initiate Data Module templates in the Navy's Common Source Database.
use_relationship:
The S1000D Data Module Requirements List shall be used to initiate Data Module templates in the Navy's Common Source Database.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to all new contracts and solicitations that acquire S1000D Issues prior to 4.0 based technical documentation.

The DID may also be applicable to technical documentation already in production for major changes and upgrades.

S1000D, referenced in this Data Item Description, can be obtained at www.s1000d.org.

references.label: NAVSEA S1000D Tagging and Authoring Guidelines

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of any documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Data Module Requirements List shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 1 and shall contain the following columns of information.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The content of the columns identified below shall follow the requirements of S1000D. All columns listed below are mandatory. Population of all columns of information is mandatory. The columns shall contain the Standard Numbering System breakdown as specified in S1000D. The Data Module Requirements List shall contain all the appropriate Data Modules required to generate the applicable technical documentation.

children.title: TITLE DMC Column
children.content: The text "DMC" shall be entered in the TITLE DMC column.

children.title: Master Naming Scheme (MNS) Column
children.content: The Master Naming Scheme shall be specific to NAVSEA's Common Source Database and shall contain model identification code and shall identify the project to which the data applies.

children.title: MODELIC Column
children.content: The MODELIC column contains the model identification code and identifies the project to which the data applies and shall be the point of reference for all applicability information. The model identification code shall include all related model variants.

children.title: SDC Column
children.content: The SDC column contains the system difference code. It indicates alternative versions of the system and subsystem/sub-subsystem identified by the Standard Numbering System without affecting the type, model or variant identity.

children.title: CHAPNUM Column
children.content: The CHAPNUM column contains the system code and is comprised of the material item category code and a code representing the general systems and the basic structure of the Product. This is the first portion of the Standard Numbering System.

children.title: SECTION Column
children.content: The SECTION column contains the subsystem portion of the second element of the Standard Numbering System and describes the further breakdown of the system.

children.title: SUBSECT Column
children.content: The SUBSECT column contains the sub-subsystem portion of the second element of the Standard Numbering System and describes the further breakdown of the system.

children.title: SUBJECT Column
children.content: The SUBJECT column contains the third element of the Standard Numbering System. It provides identification for units in complex systems.

children.title: DISCODE Column
children.content: The DISCODE column identifies the breakdown condition of an assembly to which maintenance information applies.

children.title: DISCODEV Column
children.content: The DISCODEV column identifies alternative items of equipment or components.

children.title: INCODE Column
children.content: The INCODE column identifies the type of information within a data module.

children.title: INCODEV Column
children.content: The INCODEV column identifies any variation in the activity defined by the information code.

children.title: ITEMLOC Column
children.content: The ITEMLOC column identifies where the maintenance task will be performed in relation to the equipment/system.

children.title: TECHNAME Column
children.content: The TECHNAME column identifies the nomenclature of the hardware or function.

children.title: INFONAME Column
children.content: The INFONAME column contains the short description of the information code.

children.title: DMTYPE Column
children.content: The DMTYPE column indicates the data module type to NAVSEA's common source database. This column shall be populated with selections from Table 1. Before using a schema, check the NAVSEA S1000D Tagging and Authoring Guidelines to ensure that it is supported. The Tagging and Authoring Guidelines can be obtained from https://www.navsea.navy.mil/Home/Warfare-Centers/NSWC-Carderock/Resources/Technical-Information-Systems/Navy-XML-SGML-Repository/DTDs-Schemas/NAVSEA-S1000D-Tools-Repository/.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement
preparation_instructions.content: The Data Module Requirements List shall be presented in an electronic file ASCII, comma-delimited file.
